QuestInfo.name: Falsified Remnant
QuestInfo.0: Ryden has a plan to deceive Eels...
QuestInfo.2: As Ryden requested, you brought the falsified evidence gathered from Stirges and Jr. Wraiths to Eels. He was convinced that the map indicated the secret organization's hideout...
QuestInfo.1: Ryden wants you to take falsified evidence to Eels.
QuestInfo.summary: You need to bring Eels a fake map to the secret organization's hideout. You can get the map from Stirges and Jr. Wraiths...

0.0: Muahaha... An interesting thought just occurred to me. Would you like to hear?

yes.0: You should be able to obtain Secret Maps by hunting Stirges and Jr. Wraiths. I had a bunch of them planted in those creatures a long time ago. When you collect 20 of them, they will form a map that indicates a fake location of our hideout. Collect the 20 Secret Maps and bring them to that foolish Job Instructor.
yes.1: Don't worry, that map is fake, it leads to some mountainous area near Perion. But that stupid Job Instructor will think otherwise. Quite a plan, no? Collect #b20 Secret Maps#k and bring them to the Job Instructor. I suggest you head over to the Kerning City Subway Line 1, as the place is crawling with #rStirges#k and #rJr. Wraiths#k.

no.0: Don't tell me you're as foolish as that Job Instructor! You sure you don't want to hear it?

1.0: So, did you talk to that suspicious guy?\r\n#L0##bYes, and I was able to obtain this. It looks like some sort of map...#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, let me see! This... This is amazing! A Secret Map that indicates their headquarters. Looks like you gotta piece the 20 pages together before it can be read. Very clever, I'll give them that. Let's see here... Their headquarters seems to be located in Perion... That's not far from here at all! I better have that area searched immediately... You may be young, but I see that you are very capable. Good job!

yes.0: I will notify the Dark Lord of the incredible job you've done.

npc.0: Don't worry, that map is fake, it leads to some mountainous area near Perion. But that stupid Job Instructor will think otherwise. Quite a plan, no? Collect #b20 Secret Maps#k from the Stirges and Jr. Wraiths, then bring them to him.

item.0: Did you talk to that suspicious guy?
